**New here:** loud zones everywhere (bat roost, attic fan), everything combined. Decoy: Velvet the bat.

## Main path (Jump 2 / Speed 2: steps <= 2 tiles up, gaps <= 3 tiles)

1. Up the chimney (feather) through the damper (opens at 9 rescues, a cutscene in the Carrier) to chim-top, then left into att-entry (start, save 1).
2. att-entry: the bat roost loud zone (Earplugs).
3. att-rafters (Velvet) or att-trunks (beetle sneak), then att-insulation (attic fan loud zone), att-boxes (save 2 + Ready card) -> att-lair (Nana).
4. att-hatch: the latch over the Hall (pound it): the shortcut home.

## Notes

- No item here: the beacon goes straight to the lair (Chip, house cricket voice).
- Nana's door checks the trio for low, middle and high voices (TEXT.nana).

### att-hatch: The Hatch

Old toys around the attic hatch. The hatch latch (C) in the floor (bottom edge, cols 36-41 of the room) breaks with a ground-pound and drops you into the Hall: the shortcut home. From below it can't be opened (a C clump is solid from underneath).

## Boss: nana (the lullaby)

Arena: room att-lair, 3x2 screens. Fixed chirp: radius 6 tiles, stun 0 s (never from the cricket's stats). Tell: tail-tip wiggle + rattle-swish, 0.8 s (1.2 s in Gentle Mode); emit `game.emit('tell', {x, y})` when it starts. Losing restarts the current phase (restore health). Built for Jump 2 / Speed 2. Freed: chip.

Layout: 3x2: Nana fills the back of the attic, curled around a chimney breast. Three music stones on three rafters (tuning fork low-left, glass middle, bell high-right). Rafter gaps (hiding spots) all along the floor. Chip sits in an old shoebox by her chin.

- At the door: the "Ready?" card asks for a low, a middle and a high voice (low <= 3.5 kHz: Katy, Frost, Digby; middle 4-5 kHz: Pip, Duo, Jam, Rin; high >= 5.5 kHz: Stripe, Mote). One press picks a suggested trio; the door opens once the trio covers all three.
- Phase 1: she growls (loud zones pulse: Earplugs) and sweeps her tail along the floor (the long swish; tell first). Duck into rafter gaps. Between sweeps kick each music stone once to light it. Ends: 3 stones lit.
- Phase 2: each stone glows the colour of the voice it wants; your matching portrait glows too. Swap (L1/R1) and chirp at each stone with the right voice. Ends: 3 stones sung.
- Phase 3: the chorus. Everyone (all ten rescued crickets and every Not-Cricket met) joins a short rhythm sequence: press Chirp on the beat (rings on screen; window +/-150 ms; no failure, only "louder"). 16 beats. Nana yawns, sings along a little and falls asleep. Ends: Chip is free.

Hide spots: rafter gaps (6).

Timings: tell 0.8, sweepEvery 4, beatWindowMs 150, beats 16.

Props: music-stone-fork, music-stone-glass, music-stone-bell. Gecko art: sprites/geckos/nana/ (idle, strike, sleep, body, tail, legs + meta.json; renderer's gecko rig).

Lines: TEXT.geckos.nana.pre (3) before the fight, .post (2) after.
Recorded solution: design/solutions/zone-10-boss.json with the weakest crickets available at that point.
